description: MainActivity class for an Android Wearable app that manages connection to GoogleApiClient, handles messaging with wearable nodes, and responds to button clicks to start activities on connected wearables.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages wearable messaging and starts wearable activities upon user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not already connected.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Adds message listener when GoogleApiClient connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Removes message listener when connection is suspended.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and shows appropriate toasts.

methods.name: onStartWearableActivityClick
methods.description: Sends a start activity message to connected wearable nodes when button is clicked.

methods.name: getSendMessageResultCallback
methods.description: Handles the result of message sending, logs failure if unsuccessful.
